body.name: \(\mathcal C_n\)
body.construction: On the binary-treatment inference submodel \(\mathcal A=\{d,e\}\), \(\mathcal C_n=\operatorname{cl}\bigcup\{\mathfrak I_{\Delta}^r(p,\omega):(p,\omega)\in\mathcal H_n\cap\mathfrak D_+^r\}\), with the analogous primitive-map construction for either reported arm mean. Candidate pairs with a zero cell mass are outside \(\mathfrak D_+^r\), so this image never evaluates \(m_j(p,\omega)\) at \(\pi_j=0\).
